column1: Ethics example: Moral courage and presence of mind under duress
column2: Capt. Smit Machchhar (2026): stabbed by his co-pilot mid-air, he still unlocked the cockpit so passengers could stop the attacker; all 174 landed safely.

column1: Ethics example: Institutional accountability vs individual blame
column2: Indore water deaths (2026): the inquiry called them preventable, the result of decades of delayed tenders, sewer lines over water pipes and missing records.

column1: Ethics example: Constitutional morality and conscientious objection
column2: Vande Mataram case (2026): an SC judge noted that standing respectfully without singing shouldn't be criminal, applying Bijoe Emmanuel (1986).

column1: Ethics example: Empathy and dignity in public service
column2: Bhadohi, UP (2026): a Musahar woman was refused hospital admission and gave birth by the roadside; an inquiry found the doctors seriously negligent.

column1: Ethics example: Procurement ethics (lowest cost vs quality)
column2: Delhi fake cancer-drug racket (2026): doctors blamed lowest-bidder (L1) buying for letting spurious medicines into hospitals.

column1: Ethics example: Ethics in science and technology
column2: Stanford 'xenocortication' (2026): researchers consulted bioethicists before transplanting human brain tissue into mice.

column1: Ethics example: VIP culture vs citizen-first service
column2: Assam (2026): an ambulance carrying a critical patient was held up for the CM's convoy; he then said ministers' movement must never inconvenience people.
